newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ governor to speak in parliament from 0100 GMT.
newsitem.headline: BOJ governor to speak in parliament from 0100 GMT.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita will attend a parliamentary committee meeting on Thursday, the BOJ said in a statement.
Matsushita will answer questions from members of an Upper House finance committee between 10 a.m. and 11.50 a.m. (0100 to 0250 GMT) and between 1 p.m. and 5.10 p.m. (0400 and 0810 GMT), the BOJ said.
